phase_policies.applies_when: Early game, own army composition unknown, heavy technology investment, moderate production, heavy defense. Opponent shows ground posture with Zergling and Queen cues, moderate production, light technology.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when your army composition becomes clearer or if the opponent shows signs of tech switches.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Prioritize ground strength and defense while teching up; maintain economy and expansion.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground forces, increase defense, continue economy growth, and increase technology. Maintain air and expansion.
phase_policies.title: Early Tech and Defense Focus
phase_policies.veto: Do not over-commit to air or neglect defense; avoid expanding too greedily without scouting.

phase_policies.applies_when: Early-midgame, own army unknown, heavy tech, moderate production, heavy defense. Opponent ground posture with Zergling and Queen cues, moderate production, light tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate when your army composition becomes clear or if the opponent shows signs of tech switches.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Stabilize defense and economy while continuing tech development; prepare for midgame transition.
phase_policies.target: Increase defense and economy, strengthen ground forces, continue production and tech. Maintain air and expansion.
phase_policies.title: Early-Midgame Stabilization
phase_policies.veto: Do not be too passive; avoid missing opportunities to gain map control or punish over-expansion.

phase_policies.applies_when: Midgame, own army ground-oriented with Stalkers and Oracles, heavy production and tech. Opponent ground posture with Zerglings, Queens, and Overseers, heavy production and tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of air tech or if your army composition needs adjustment.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Focus on strengthening ground army while maintaining solid economy and defense; avoid over-expansion.
phase_policies.target: Strengthen ground forces, continue production and tech, maintain defense and economy. Do not over-expand.
phase_policies.title: Midgame Ground Transition
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect air defense if opponent techs to Mutalisks; avoid over-expanding.

phase_policies.applies_when: Late-midgame, own army air-oriented with Stalkers and Oracles, heavy production and tech. Opponent ground posture with Zerglings and Queens, heavy production, moderate tech.
phase_policies.live_check: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of anti-air tech or if your air army is not effective.
phase_policies.routing_summary: Commit to air superiority while maintaining production and tech; keep defense and economy stable.
phase_policies.target: Increase air forces, strengthen air army, continue production and tech, maintain defense and economy.
phase_policies.title: Late-Midgame Air Transition
phase_policies.veto: Do not neglect anti-air defense if opponent techs to anti-air; avoid over-expanding.

experiment_feedback.use_boundary: Prioritize execution risks only; never infer the strategic target from agent outcomes.
